top_news.title: Nepal Billionaire: Rebuilding After Flood to Cost $5B
top_news.summary: Binod Chaudhary, Chairman & President of Chaudhary Group, says efforts to rebuild Nepal’s infrastructure after a devastating flash flood this week could cost at least $5 billion. He also said the amount his group will be spending on this effort will be higher than it did in 2015, when a deadly earthquake had sparked similar nationwide reconstruction work. He appeared exclusively on Bloomberg's "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: India’s Cheap Weight-Loss Drugs Get A Reality Check
top_news.summary:
Cheaper weight-loss drugs were expected to take off in India. But despite GLP-1s costing as little as $14 a month, demand has been slower than expected. From stigma to hesitant doctors, Satviki Sanjay explains why price isn’t the only barrier.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Inside India's AI Ambitions
top_news.summary: India's big AI bet is backed by government incentives and investments from global tech giants, and it's aiming to become a key hub in the AI economy. Bloomberg's Saritha Rai reports on whether it can translate this massive spending into a lasting advantage. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: 4,000% Options Surge in 15 Minutes Shows Wild India Auction
top_news.summary: India’s new closing-auction system was meant to improve end-of-day prices. In the options market, however, the mechanism is producing extreme swings that are creating and wiping out gains in minutes.

top_news.title: Ex-RBI Chief Rajan Says Fed Should Raise Rates
top_news.summary: Former Reserve Bank of India Governor, Raghuram Rajan, says the US Federal Reserve should raise interest rates to contain accelerating inflation. Rajan, who is also serving on a task force set up to examine the US central bank, says he believes financial conditions are not restrictive at this point. He joined Bloomberg's Insight with Haslinda Amin from Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: PHP/USD: Philippine Peso Falls Past 62 Per Dollar on Elevated Oil Prices
top_news.summary: The Philippine peso weakened past 62 per dollar on Friday, breaching a closely-watched level and adding to pressure on the benchmark stock index as the gauge heads for its biggest monthly drop since March.

top_news.title: Traders Focus on Jackson Hole, Fed Outlook | The Asia Trade 8/28/2026
top_news.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Inside India's AI Ambitions | Bloomberg Tech: Asia 8/28/2026
top_news.summary:
India is aiming to become a global AI powerhouse, backed by billions of dollars in chipmaking and technology investment. But major challenges remain, including a shortage of computing infrastructure, shifting venture capital priorities, and growing concerns over job displacement. This episode explores the opportunities and obstacles shaping India's AI ambitions.

top_news.title: Chinese Carmakers Grow Market Share in Europe With Hybrid Surge
top_news.summary: Chinese automakers’ share of new-car sales in Europe topped 11% last month, as consumers continue to snap up more affordable plug-in hybrids.

top_news.title: BYD’s $20 Billion Stock Comeback May Extend on Export Success
top_news.summary: After a stock rally that added nearly $20 billion to its market value in about two months, BYD Co. faces a key test to demonstrate strength overseas despite geopolitical headwinds.
